name: Ford - Lima Engine Plant, Lima OH

fieldNotes.site: Ford Lima Engine Plant, 1155 Bible Rd, Lima (Allen County) OH - active Ford powertrain plant (produces V6/V8 engines, ~1,500+ employees). Roster geocode (40.7775,-84.0866) lands directly on the large multi-roof plant building - confirmed correct. The plant sits on the semi-rural edge of Lima, surrounded by farmland and woods, with rail lines on the west and east sides and Bible Rd along the south.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed - Street View (2024-08) along Bible Rd shows a marked 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' sign on the chain-link perimeter fence at a wide paved entry apron (~40.7743,-84.0820 area). Chain-link fence encircles the property; the truck entrance opens off Bible Rd into a deep paved staging apron before the internal gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Marked true at medium confidence - a fenced ~1,500-employee active Ford engine plant of this scale conventionally operates a staffed gatehouse, and the truck entrance has a controlled fenced checkpoint. A booth structure could not be positively resolved at Street-View distance; flagged uncertain. remoteGs false as a consequence.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: True - the truck entrance off Bible Rd opens onto a large, deep paved apron well outside the building, providing clear pre-gate truck staging room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: True - the approach from the Bible Rd truck entrance to the dock yard is long and deep with ample room to queue 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: The north-side drop yard holds an estimated 25-40 parked trailers in rows (z18/z19 imagery); banded 25-50. dropYard true. trailersVisible ~30.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 10-25 dock doors along the north building face serving the truck yard; exact count partly obscured by roof angle - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Marked false (medium confidence) - the main freight operation (docks + drop yard) is concentrated on the north side; no clearly separate second dock cluster confirmed. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail lines run along both the west and east sides of the property with spurs connecting toward the plant - rail-served.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: True - the Bible Rd truck entrance apron is very wide with substantial unused paved width; physical room exists for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: False - a single large interconnected plant building (multi-roof but one structure); buildingCount 1.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: The plant is on the semi-rural northeast edge of Lima, surrounded by farmland and woodland - Rural.
